tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and sheet background (iOS grouped background). Section headers, footnotes and large titles sit on it.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: Grouped rows, shop tiles and the offer panel, on `bg`.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: The rounded frame behind a device photo inside a row (`cell` around it).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Steppers, segmented controls and grade chips, on `cell` or `bg`.

tokens.name: seg-on
tokens.usage: The chosen segment of a segmented control, on `fill`.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows (half a pixel, inset 16px) and the stepper divider.

tokens.name: grabber
tokens.usage: The sheet grabber and row chevrons. Decorative only.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg` and `cell`: titles, row names, prices.

tokens.name: label-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg` and `cell`: specs, section headers, footnotes. 5.4:1 on `bg` light, 6.6:1 on `cell` dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The general accent for shopping and anything with no service: links, nav buttons, block buttons, focus rings. 5.2:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: trade
tokens.usage: Trade-in's colour in sheets: nav buttons, the Pay button, the setting icon, the Trade-in applied mark. 4.5:1 on `bg`, 5:1 on `cell`.

tokens.name: on-trade
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `trade` fill.

tokens.name: wholesale
tokens.usage: Wholesale's colour in sheets: nav buttons, the Sell button.

tokens.name: on-wholesale
tokens.usage: Text on a `wholesale` fill.

tokens.name: credit
tokens.usage: Money coming to the customer: a trade-in credit, an offer, a payout. On `cell` (5.4:1 light).

tokens.name: strike
tokens.usage: The line through an old price. The price itself stays `label-2`.

tokens.name: switch-on
tokens.usage: A switch that is on. iOS green; the knob's position also says on or off.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: A switch that is off.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob.

tokens.name: buying
tokens.usage: The dot before a You're buying section header. Always beside the words.

tokens.name: selling
tokens.usage: The dot before a You're selling section header. Always beside the words.

tokens.name: example-bg
tokens.usage: The Example tag on made-up prices.

tokens.name: example-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the Example tag, on `example-bg`.

tokens.name: save-bg
tokens.usage: The savings pill under a shop price.

tokens.name: save-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the savings pill, on `save-bg`.

tokens.name: trade-card-top
tokens.usage: Trade-in fade, top: green. Cards and stages, both themes.

tokens.name: trade-card-mid
tokens.usage: Trade-in fade at 48%, behind the glass boxes.

tokens.name: trade-card-low
tokens.usage: Trade-in fade, bottom: dark green, behind the button row.

tokens.name: trade-card-glow
tokens.usage: Deepens the bottom-left corner under the button.

tokens.name: trade-card-glow-2
tokens.usage: Deepens the bottom-right corner.

tokens.name: trade-card-ink
tokens.usage: Titles, box labels and the badge mark on the trade-in fade (4.7:1 at the very top, more below).

tokens.name: trade-card-ink-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow and lede on the trade-in fade.

tokens.name: trade-card-ink-3
tokens.usage: The arrow and other marks on the trade-in fade.

tokens.name: trade-card-glass
tokens.usage: Glass boxes, the badge and the Trade-in applied chip on the trade-in fade.

tokens.name: trade-card-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a glass box on the trade-in fade.

tokens.name: trade-card-shine
tokens.usage: The 1px highlight along a glass box's top edge.

tokens.name: trade-card-select
tokens.usage: A chosen or hovered glass box.

tokens.name: trade-card-mark
tokens.usage: Counts and the chosen box's edge: mint on the green.

tokens.name: trade-card-on-mark
tokens.usage: Text on `trade-card-mark`.

tokens.name: trade-card-shadow
tokens.usage: The drop shadow under device photos on the trade-in fade.

tokens.name: trade-card-btn
tokens.usage: The card's mint button, in the dark bottom row.

tokens.name: trade-card-on-btn
tokens.usage: Text on `trade-card-btn` (12.7:1).

tokens.name: trade-card-foot-note
tokens.usage: The small note beside the button, on the dark bottom.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-top
tokens.usage: Wholesale fade, top: grey. Cards and stages, both themes.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-mid
tokens.usage: Wholesale fade at 48%, behind the glass boxes.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-low
tokens.usage: Wholesale fade, bottom: black, behind the button row.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-glow
tokens.usage: Deepens the bottom-left corner under the button.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-glow-2
tokens.usage: No second glow on wholesale.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-ink
tokens.usage: Titles, box labels and the badge mark on the wholesale fade (5.3:1 at the very top, more below).

tokens.name: wholesale-card-ink-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow and lede on the wholesale fade.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-ink-3
tokens.usage: The arrow and other marks on the wholesale fade.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-glass
tokens.usage: Glass boxes and the badge on the wholesale fade.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a glass box on the wholesale fade.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-shine
tokens.usage: The 1px highlight along a glass box's top edge.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-select
tokens.usage: A chosen or hovered glass box.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-mark
tokens.usage: Counts and the result box's edge: light grey on the grey.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-on-mark
tokens.usage: Text on `wholesale-card-mark`.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-shadow
tokens.usage: The drop shadow under device photos on the wholesale fade.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-btn
tokens.usage: The card's light button, in the dark bottom row.

tokens.name: wholesale-card-on-btn
tokens.usage: Text on `wholesale-card-btn` (15:1).

tokens.name: wholesale-card-foot-note
tokens.usage: The small note beside the button, on the dark bottom.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The one title at the top of a sheet or page.

styles.name: nav-title
styles.usage: The centre of a sheet's nav bar. Nav buttons are the same size at 400.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: A device's name in a row.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Sheet copy and the subtitle under a large title.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Specs under a device name, section headers (uppercase), footnotes.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: The total row of a summary.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: A service card's title (shrinks to 21px on a phone).

styles.name: card-lede
styles.usage: The line under a card title (12.5px on a phone).
styles.sample: Pick one to see your offer.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a card title.

styles.name: box-label
styles.usage: The label under a device in a glass box.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: The small note beside a card's button.
styles.sample: Your offer first · then pick a device

styles.name: price-tile
styles.usage: The price on a shop tile.

styles.name: price-was
styles.usage: The struck old price beside it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a large title and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The sheet's top padding; gaps inside a price row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a row's photo and its text; between shop tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, section-header inset, page gutter, shop tile padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Above a section header.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a page's section title; the offer panel's padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The bottom of a page.

tokens.name: radius-chip

tokens.name: radius-icon

tokens.name: radius-control

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: The frame behind a device photo in a row.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Grouped lists and the offer panel.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Full-width sheet buttons.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Glass boxes and shop tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Service cards and stages.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
